_about: A made-up application inventory. Each app carries the disposition a human architect chose (expected). The agent never sees that field; the eval compares the agent's calls with it.

apps.name: ORDER-ENTRY
apps.technology: COBOL and CICS on a z/OS mainframe
apps.notes: Core revenue path. The business wants weekly pricing changes; today each change takes a six-week release. Two of the three developers who know it retire within two years.

apps.name: HR-REPORTS
apps.notes: Every report now exists in the HR SaaS rolled out last year. The server is out of vendor support.

apps.name: CLAIMS-PORTAL
apps.notes: The code is in good shape and well tested. The pain is the WebLogic licence and slow manual deployments.

apps.name: PRICING-ENGINE
apps.technology: Go services on Kubernetes with CI/CD
apps.notes: Built cloud-native two years ago. Meets its service levels.

apps.name: DOC-ARCHIVE
apps.technology: .NET Framework 4.8 on Windows VMs in the company data center
apps.notes: Rarely changes and works. The data center lease ends in nine months.
